extracted.intended_audience: researchers, institutions, and prospective grantees seeking funding from Schmidt Sciences
extracted.subtask_description: Organization homepage describing Schmidt Sciences' mission, priority research centers, programmatic priorities, and how funding is distributed (open calls / RFPs). Useful for prospective applicants to understand focus areas and submission policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application submission policy
rubrics_metrics.description: We proactively seek out grant opportunities and do not accept unsolicited proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Schmidt Sciences does not accept unsolicited proposals; prospective applicants must respond to the organization's listed open calls/RFPs to apply for funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding mechanism: open calls / RFPs
rubrics_metrics.description: Please find our current open calls listed below. (Examples shown: 2026 AI for Actionable Matter Modeling; 2026 Humanities and Artificial Intelligence Virtual Institute (HAVI) RFP; 2026 Science of Trustworthy AI RFP; 2026 Unconventional Compute RFP; Research Frontiers Network (IIT Delhi): Net-Zero India.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding is distributed via specific program announcements and RFPs; applicants should apply only through those active opportunities and follow their application instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program priorities: bold science and deep, continuous collaborations
rubrics_metrics.description: Bold science, deep and continuous collaborations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Schmidt Sciences emphasizes supporting ambitious, high-impact scientific efforts and sustained collaborative relationships rather than one-off or small-scale projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tailored program support to specific hypotheses or challenges
rubrics_metrics.description: Within each of our five centers, we organize scientific support through programs and projects—tailored to the needs of each specific hypothesis or challenge.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs and projects are designed to match the particular needs of a hypothesis or challenge; proposal fit should align with a center’s defined programmatic approach rather than generic project descriptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of supported research: basic to pressing planetary problems
rubrics_metrics.description: Our team supports researchers pursuing hypotheses that address everything from basic-science questions to pressing problems facing the planet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Schmidt Sciences funds a spectrum of work from fundamental/basic science to applied research addressing urgent global problems; proposals should make clear where they sit on this spectrum and how they map to the center’s priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Center focus — AI & Advanced Computing
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting AI research and tools to accelerate breakthroughs across fields
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should advance AI and computing research or develop tools that enable breakthroughs in other scientific domains; interdisciplinary impact is valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Center focus — Astrophysics & Space
rubrics_metrics.description: Unveiling the mysteries of the Universe with rapid realizations of innovative technology
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funded work should aim to reveal new astrophysical insights and/or rapidly realize novel space technologies; emphasis on innovation and timely deployment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Center focus — Biosciences
rubrics_metrics.description: Harnessing biology's infinite possibilities at its intersection with chemistry, physics, and engineering
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects that integrate biology with chemistry, physics, and engineering to open new scientific directions are within scope; interdisciplinary approaches are encouraged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Center focus — Climate
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting climate research to bend the carbon curve and secure a sustainable future
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding targets research that meaningfully reduces emissions, improves understanding of the carbon cycle, or otherwise contributes to a sustainable future; impact on climate mitigation/adaptation is a priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Center focus — Science Systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Breaking down barriers to scientific discovery by supporting people, tools, and communities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals that strengthen research infrastructure, build scientific communities, or develop tools and systems that accelerate discovery are sought; social and organizational aspects of science are included.
